text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer. Please take a look."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The dawn breeze— It is sunrise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I caught my breath. Spreading out before 
my eyes were soft pink auspicious clouds 
and the dazzling glow of the morning sun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The time rewinds to several hours earlier.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year began amid the ringing of the 
Joya no Kane. After finishing our shrine 
visit and heading home—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Mixed into the downhill gale comes a 
gentle spring breeze... It is already that 
time of year, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. What a coincidence. Were you also 
beckoned by the refreshing breeze?
choice_data_list: No, I just came to pay my respects...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see. May you have a wonderful year.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...I must be on my way soon. Until next 
time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, curfew is long past, and it's 
dark outside. I can't just let her go 
alone like this."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Where to... Just wherever the wind takes 
me...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I only walk where I am called.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, I followed after her 
as she drifted lightly along—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And waiting at our destination was the 
very first sunrise of the new year.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...It's beautiful. So this is what the 
auspicious wind was inviting us to."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The first breeze of spring blows through 
iridescent clouds... carrying light as it 
races north, south, and west.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It seems a new wind has been summoned.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...May another year of wonderful days 
begin for us all."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Now then. An east wind, or a south 
wind?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The blowing wind is a tailwind. I feel 
like running down like a whirlwind and 
beckoning the gale myself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like a waste to turn our backs 
on this morning breeze."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps, on this clear, festive day, an 
unseen wind might blow.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what do you think? I cannot 
decide which way this wind should blow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems she's asking for advice 
regarding her future schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Beckoning winds... Should we train, take 
in the scenery for a while longer, or is 
there a third option?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "Beckoning winds, was it?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I see. The first spring storm only 
comes once a year. Indeed, we must not let 
this opportunity slip by.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ――…… *pant*, *pant*, *gasp*……!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Further forward, even faster...! Here, I 
shall become the spring gale...!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Taaahh-!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "...Haa, haa, phew... ...Fufu."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Today, I could feel the wind more than 
ever. A spring breeze dancing with 
blossoms on its wings.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ……May I do one more set?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day, Yamanin Zephyr was unusually 
light on her feet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And thus, a new year began.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The scenery... Yes, it would truly be a 
waste to leave without bathing in this 
first spring breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Now then, let us take a seat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to take it easy for a 
little while longer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Just bathing in the sun, feeling the 
breeze, and listening to the trees brings 
me fine weather in my heart."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Oh my, hehe. Trainer, look over there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking in the direction she pointed—

text_block_list.name: Hawk
text_block_list.text: Beep... beep...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A large hawk soared gracefully across the 
open sky.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Truly like the King of the Spring Breeze. 
I have witnessed something truly 
magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It looks like it will be a wonderful year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And thus, a new year began.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then let us go forth to see a wind 
we have never witnessed before.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Gentle as a spring breeze, following 
wherever the wind takes me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we headed down the mountain for 
a while, following Yamanin Zephyr's whims—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the plum blossoms... Their buds have 
already swollen so much, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...It smells lovely.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Soon, when the spring breeze blows, the 
plum blossoms... and the cherry blossoms 
will bloom.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And now, time moves into April. ...I need 
to brace myself and stay focused.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And thus, a new year began.
